modules.title: Introduction to Probability and Statistics (Advanced)
modules.html:
Probability distributions, expectation and variance. This section covers introduction to probability and statistics (advanced).

Key points

  • The probability of an event A occurring is 0.3. What is the probability of A not occurring — $$0.7$$.
  • Three coins are tossed. Probability of getting 3 heads is: — $$1/8$$.
  • A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. Probability of picking a red ball is: — $$3/5$$.
  • Three coins are tossed. Find the probability of getting exactly two heads. — $$\frac{3}{8}$$.
  • The probability of an event $A$ is $2/3$ and event $B$ is $1/4$. If they are independent, find $P(A \\cap B)$. — $1/6$.

Worked examples

Q: The probability of an event A occurring is 0.3. What is the probability of A not occurring?
A: $$0.7$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$0.7$$.

Q: Three coins are tossed. Probability of getting 3 heads is:
A: $$1/8$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$1/8$$.
